humanRationale: a possibly garbled source phrase cannot be silently repaired into an authorized relationship fact; 'hate themselves' != explicitly 'hate each other' != mutually hostile brothers who bicker. Under the closed-world standard, those concretizations warrant bounded MINOR revision.
materialIssues: curiosityHook: 'stubborn brothers who can barely stand the sight of each other' adds an unsupported personality trait and resolves the authorized source's ambiguous/possibly malformed 'hate themselves' wording into a definite mutual-hostility relationship that the frozen source does not explicitly establish.

description: 'mutually hostile brothers' makes the same unsupported relationship resolution; the protocol cannot silently correct 'hate themselves' into 'hate each other' and then treat that correction as source authority.
